title: Burnout 3: Takedown
japaneseTitle: バーンアウト3 テイクダウン
shortDescription: Criterion Games' adrenaline-fueled arcade racing masterpiece, turning high-speed crashes into an art form with the revolutionary 'Takedown' mechanic.
historicalSignificance: Holds a staggering 94 Metacritic score, universally hailed as one of the greatest arcade racing games ever created by turning offensive vehicular destruction into a core speed mechanic.

editorialContent.overview: Directed by Alex Ward at British studio Criterion Games, Burnout 3 elevated arcade racing into visceral combat: instead of penalizing contact, players are rewarded with turbo boosts for aggressively slamming rivals into guardrails, oncoming semitrucks, and concrete pillars.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pioneered the 'Takedown' mechanic, rewarding aggressive shunts with instant boost meter expansion, accompanied by the legendary 'Crash Mode' where players launch vehicles into crowded intersections to trigger multi-million dollar chain-reaction pileups with 'Aftertouch' steering.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Pushed Criterion's RenderWare engine to the bleeding edge on PS2 and Xbox, rendering 60 FPS motion blur, sparks, and crumpling metal physics accompanied by licensed mid-2000s pop-punk anthems.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Completely redefined the arcade racing genre, influencing everything from Need for Speed to MotorStorm and Split/Second.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on original PS2 and Xbox DVD-ROM discs, playable via backwards compatibility.

awards: BAFTA Video Games Award for Racing 2005

technicalSpecs.soundChip: Dolby Digital 5.1 / Pro Logic II with EA Trax
